sources.title: SteadyDancer: Harmonized AI Human Image Animation Generation
sources.snippet: SteadyDancer is a human image animation framework with first-frame preservation. Built on the Image-to-Video paradigm, it achieves state-of-the-art performance in appearance fidelity and motion control while handling spatio-temporal misalignments.
